reviews.x: I am in love with these little travel containers!  I read the reviews that said they have an odor, which is typical of silicone, so I immediately disassembled these upon arrival and soaked them in hot water and dish detergent. Voilá! No more smell. I traveled via plane with these and they are completely leak proof, including the bottle holding my liquid toner! I love that these come apart completely and can be tossed in the dishwasher. Would definitely recommend!!!

These are definitely leakproof. I had to knock off a few starts though because the material has an odd smell. All of my products began to smell like it and my mouthwash tasted weird after being stored in one of these containers.

reviews.t: great for travel or whenever, also BPA food grade  material- opens up options for use!
reviews.x: These are great. I love the look- nice colors and design. Just the right size for travel, and are TSA approved sizes. Easy to use, easy to clean, good seals. I don't travel much but my husband does often for work- sometimes by plane often by car. Either way, he has to pack toiletries. With six squeeze bottles and 3 tubs, he has some and I have kept a few for my own use. The fact that they are BPA free food grade silicone opens up some options for use of these bottles- whether traveling or for ou

Super nice for color-coding products. I have thin shampoos in some which don't leak but I wouldn't say they'd be entirely squish proof traveling unprotected. But they are pretty child proof containers. I'll use them to condense all my product bottles and take them when I shower elsewhere.
The colors are much less vibrant in reality.  The green is more of an army green, & the "red" is actually pink.  Kind of disappointing.

I bought the travel containers to fill with lotions and sanitizer to keep in my purse and car. They are so cute and fun that I have given a couple fill with my favorite lotions to my daughters. They like them as much as I do. They're cute, fun and practical. It's crazy that I consider a travel container as fun, but I do.

Really like these travel bottles. I love the different colors as they are both aesthetically pleasing and are helpful for differentiating between what's in the bottles. I also love the little containers. I have used them for medications, as well as putting a small amount of face lotion in, transferring some from a larger tub.  The material used on the tubes is pretty thick and seems very durable.  Would buy again!

Took these containers to my Denver trip and they worked amazing! They made it through without spilling or any damage. Only con is that once squishing them to dispense the liquid they stay sucked in for a few seconds but didn’t bother me at all considering how leak proof they’re. 10/10 would recommend! Not to mention how cute the colors and designs are ❤️

One of the bottles changed shape or melted in a checked bag. It contained sunblock which separated and looked like small balls of sand. The sunblock was not usable. Another product for cleaning my face that was very gentle stuck to the sides of the inside of the container. I ended up throwing all but one container away. Moisturizer in my carry-on was OK.

This product leaks! It leaked the first time I used it.  The first use was for a simple car trip.  To make sure it wasn't because I didn't put the cap on well enough, I cleaned it and left it upside-down on the counter.  It leaked again.  Glad I didn't fly with them! Disappointed...waste of money.

I needed new travel containers so decided to get TSA approved stuff in case I decide to fly somewhere. These bottles and jars are pretty and functional. The lids close firmly and don't leak. They are pretty and fit in my travel bag real well.
I purchased these in July 2021 for carry on luggage and they leaked everywhere. I’m now on the hunt for new ones once again.

I guess you get what you pay for! The little containers that came along w the silicon containers were very cheap and cracked. They broke almost immediately (the smaller clear ones). As far as the silicone containers, they’re not leak proof. Also, the way they dispense is odd. When you squeeze out your product, a lot shoots out. The way I was able to control that was placing a finger at the spout basically and controlled it that way. Also, I’m not sure if the dye of the silicone leaks or what, bu

Perfect size for my style of travel.  I don't need 3 oz. containers when these 2.4 oz. ones contain more than enough product--leaving room to spare in my TSA one qt. bag. Great quality, absolutely LEAK-PROOF!! Love the non-slip raised designs and the beautiful color assortment to differentiate between products.  Also, they stand up easily, do not roll off a counter and have a very secure snap-on flip cap. When some product has been used from the container, gently squeeze out excess air, then the

Edit- I ended up throwing these (and the hand sanitizer inside) in the garbage. The smell never dissipated like I hoped they would and starting making other items in my cabinet stink. I don’t have a sensitive nose and normally smells don’t bother me but this was too much  These bottles look nice and are well made. Unfortunately anything you put in them ends up with a horrible smell. I put lotion in one and hand sanitizer in another and both came out smelling disgusting. I had to wash my hands im

Should have heeded bad reviews. I'm used to things arriving contaminated by fragrance. I leave them in quarantine to air out b4 using & then wash multiple times depending what it is. But this is like laundry softener, sickening strong smell. As others stated that I wish I'd listened to; I cannot get the stench off of them. No waiting or washing is cutting it. And wasn't able to return in time. Really wanted to love - or even like them. Instead: total regret.

These are odd in the sense that some products that you put inside of them change into a thicker version of the product. It has happened to more than one product. One body wash affected the bottle itself, and I had to toss that one bottle.
So great that TSA stole them out of my bag. The two the left worked great

reviews.t: The best travel bottles I've ever owned
reviews.x: This set is perfect for any type of travel. It's obviously important that they are TSA approved sizes so you can travel with them in your carry-on. There are 6 bottles and 3 jars. The jars are pretty standard. They are listed for creams (not liquids), but I also use containers like this for pills and jewelry when traveling. The bottles are a nice silicone material and have a cross valve, so the liquid inside doesn't come out until you squeeze the bottle. I tested out liquid in the bottles and I

reviews.t: They work, but wish there was some way to label them
reviews.x: These are nice little silicon bottles. They meet the TSA requirements. We had no issues travelling with them through security. No leaks. They have a rubber topper on the hole to prevent leaks, which is nice. (I have other silicone bottles with that same feature but with those you have to apply so much pressure to get the shampoo or soap out of the bottle that you end up squirting out way more than you want. These bottle are much easier to control and squirt out the exact amount you want. They ar

I’m thrilled with these! I love that they are flexible! The hard ones always cracked on me eventually. I’m so glad I found these. I can’t say for sure they won’t leak, since I have not used them yet. But I tested them with water and they didn’t. So I think they will be fine. I’ll update my review if anything changes. But I love them and the colors and so pretty too!

reviews.t: Great alternative to cheap hard plastic containers!
reviews.x: These are a great alternative to the cheap hard plastic travel containers. I love the silicon so that you can squeeze most of the product out and it also makes washing them easier so you can use them again and again! The lid is difficult to open and close, which makes me feel better about traveling with them! I love that you get so many for the price!

I was iffy about them because of the price and because there are so Many to choose from but these are nice and easy to fill and to squeeze It’s a soft rubber material And to top it off they are cute and with just one I had enough shampoo for a week long stay

As a frequent traveler, I’m always looking for items to make the experience smoother. These were perfect for my needs. I was able to take shampoo, conditioner, facial toner, body lotion, and my Noxema with zero leakage or waste. Highly recommend.

containers looks to be very good but have not had a chance to try them out.  They arrived quickly though and so far, I am satisfied with the quality.  Time will tell.  They appear to be easy to fill and the colors and designs on them are pretty.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bottles leak-proof and reliable for travel.
Some reviewers report the bottles leaked, including on car trips and carry-on luggage.
A silicone odor is a recurring complaint, though some say it goes away after washing.
Reviewers like the colors for organizing and differentiating products, but some say the actual colors are less vibrant than shown.
The bottles are praised as the right size and TSA-approved for travel.
